item.text: {"prompt":"Create a square, edge-to-edge nonrepresentational abstract painting with no border or surrounding setting. Evoke a mind holding several competing currents at once: concentrated, controlled intensity pressing against restless, branching motion, with moments of quiet suspension. Build the composition from dense, layered fields of deep ultramarine, near-black violet, and oxidized teal, cut through by sharp strokes of warm vermilion, pale mineral gold, and chalk white. Let broad, dragged brush marks collide with fine scratches, translucent washes, granular deposits, and abrupt dry-brush gestures. Vary the rhythm between compressed clusters and generous areas of open, softly veiled color; create spatial tension through asymmetry, interrupted edges, overlapping layers, and strong shifts in scale and contrast. Keep the surface tactile and visibly worked, with subtle irregularity and no polished digital gradients. Purely abstract: no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text."}
